name: desktop_screen_capture
description:
Capture a screenshot of the full screen or a specific region and save it as a PNG file.

If `region` is provided, only that portion of the screen is captured.
`path` sets the output file path; if omitted a temp file is created automatically.
Returns the saved path, image dimensions, and an image attachment.

region.description: Capture only this region {x, y, width, height}; omit for full screen

windowTitle.description: Capture only the window whose title contains this substring

windowId.description: Capture the window with this numeric X11 window ID. Overrides windowTitle.

path.description: Output file path (PNG). Defaults to a temp file.
